interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.51.0 fixes Windows paths beyond MAX_PATH (with explicit path_too_long classification), redacts credential lines and PEM blocks in SessionStart outputs, deduplicates Antigravity Stop checkpoints when executionNum is 0 or absent, makes fresh /vault-init vaults pass healthcheck with zero management issues, repairs the English README overview and stale 0.48.0 refs, and adds an opt-in BizRouter Decisions adapter (google/gemini-decision-1 via BIZROUTER_API_KEY, plus --escalate-bizrouter low-confidence escalation on jev_ask.py while keeping TypeSafe Jev default). Retained from v0.50.0: opt-in --worktree-heads lists linked worktrees whose detached HEAD no local branch or tag contains (its --help option realigns the six existing option lines by one column), and repository PR CI cancels superseded runs. The seven certificate-bound checker files are unchanged from v0.46.0 through v0.51.0. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. For transitions from v0.45.1 or earlier, where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
